payload.body: Selected and completed Pareto portfolio: independent ggen consumer realization; reusable marketplace independent-consumer court primitive; chatgpt-cloud-elixir consumer of the shared court. Exact candidate->merge: ggen 4870c241cd0e4dd48ebf16abefb5f2474fd36118 -> f1c8e849f0b8045cc453e7d04a609e868d990637; marketplace 4715c562c3dd2c073c0ca119edbc013647978cae -> 1bce7b3aa9cc74675126a6f2b9778a2331226824; cloud e6d9cdf0d13f957e0c47848480e3ee7cfdd9ab76 -> 2117c4a06b715ef1a852654de0d210859a09d4ee. Reusable primitive: epistemic-sensor-factory-pack/tools/consumer_court.py + consumer admission schema. Consumers developed and exact-head qualified: ggen, chatgpt-cloud-elixir. New semantic commits=14 (6+5+3), all contained through 3 merged PRs. Y_observed_full_run=2 new external qualified consumer actions / 14 commits = 0.143; primitive-local Y=2/5=0.4; future Y=UNKNOWN. M>=3: remembered frontier selected two PARTIAL_ALIVE external targets, and concurrent memory exposed TensorFlow as an additional actionable edge. ERRC: eliminate duplicated verifier logic; reduce authority ambiguity/evidence coupling; raise exact-head qualification/reuse/fanout; create generic court/schema and two consumers. 1000X: reusable primitive leverage demonstrated; consumer replication increased from R=1 to R>=3 total qualified contexts if producer-self is counted, with 2 independently qualified external consumers; 10x fanout and 10x downstream composition remain unobserved. Preserved alternatives: TensorFlow and all other writable compatible consumers. Handoff: enumerate consumers of merged court, qualify TensorFlow when write authority exists, measure downstream unlocks per consumer.
